title: Factory Finance Manager
description:
Act as the financial business partner to the Plant Operations and Supply Chain teams, driving cost optimization, operational efficiency, and financial discipline across manufacturing and logistics activities. The role ensures accurate performance reporting, supports strategic decision-making, and delivers insights that enhance profitability and cash flow.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead plant-level budgeting, forecasting, and monthly performance reporting. Translate operational drivers into financial outcomes and ensure alignment with regional targets.
* Drive cost optimization through detailed analysis of manufacturing variances, yield performance, and labor efficiency. Partner with operations to identify and track savings initiatives.
* Act as the financial advisor to Plant and Supply Chain leaders, providing insights, scenario analysis, and financial guidance for operational and strategic decisions.
* Monitor inventory health, obsolescence, and working capital efficiency. Support standard cost setting, BOM validation, and ensure accurate reflection of plant economics in SAP.
* Evaluate CapEx proposals, conduct post-investment reviews, and provide financial leadership for CI, Lean, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Ensure adherence to McCormick's financial policies, internal controls, and SOX requirements, maintaining high standards of reporting accuracy and governance.

**Desired Skills/ Qualifications:**

* Qualified CA.
* 7+ years of work experience with business partnering exposure
* Previous experience in a Supply chain & procurement finance environments desirable
* Strong understanding of Accounts / Finance functions
* Experience of working on SAP is essential.

title: Senior Associate
description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary\*\*
  
  
The Senior Associate will play a key role in supporting financial operations, client services, and project management within SS&C Technologies. This position requires a proactive and detail-oriented individual with a strong understanding of financial services and excellent analytical skills.
  
  
Job Responsibilities\*\*
  
  

* Perform complex data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting for various financial products and services.
* Manage and prioritize multiple client requests and projects, ensuring timely and accurate completion.
* Act as a primary point of contact for client inquiries, resolving issues and escalating as necessary.
* Assist in the development and implementation of new processes and procedures to enhance operational efficiency.
* Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
* Participate in internal and external audits, providing required documentation and support.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of comprehensive documentation for processes and systems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve departmental and company objectives.

Job Qualifications\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in financial services, operations, or a similar analytical role.
* Proven ability to analyze complex data sets and present findings clearly and concisely.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, advanced formulas).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with clients and colleagues.
* Demonstrated problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with financial software platforms (e.g., Confluence, Advent, BlackRock Aladdin) is a plus.

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.
  
  
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

title: Articled Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Jain Prerna & Co. is a professional accounting and advisory firm committed to delivering reliable, accurate, and timely financial services to individuals and organizations. The firm focuses on building long-term client relationships through integrity, transparency, and personalized service. Team members are encouraged to develop strong technical skills and professional judgment in a supportive learning environment. Jain Prerna & Co. offers exposure to a variety of assignments, helping aspiring professionals gain practical experience and grow in their careers.

**Role Description**
The Articled Assistant will work full time on-site at the Jain Prerna & Co. office in Sonipat. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with audits, tax return preparation, accounting entries, and financial statement compilation under the guidance of senior team members. The role involves maintaining working papers, supporting documentation, and client records in an organized and accurate manner. The Articled Assistant will also help in conducting basic financial analysis, complying with relevant standards and regulations, and coordinating with clients for data collection and clarification. This position provides hands-on training, exposure to professional ethics, and opportunities to learn firm procedures and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong basics in accounting principles, financial reporting, and taxation.
* Candidates should possess skills in using spreadsheets and accounting software, along with general computer literacy.
* Candidates should possess good analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Candidates should possess effective written and verbal communication skills to interact with team members and clients.
* Candidates should possess time-management and organizational skills to handle multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Enrollment in or completion of a relevant professional course (such as CA or equivalent) is highly beneficial.
* Willingness to learn, maintain professional ethics, and work collaboratively in a team environment is essential.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
NTNNEI MANUFACTURING INDIA PVT LTD is an industrial manufacturing organization operating in India with a facility in Rewari. The company focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality manufactured products to domestic and international customers. It emphasizes operational efficiency, process discipline, and continuous improvement in its production and support functions. Team members are encouraged to contribute to streamlined workflows and robust compliance practices, especially in finance and accounting. The organization values professionals who support accurate financial reporting and strong internal controls to enable sustainable growth.
  
**Role Description**
The Accountant role is a full-time, on-site position based in Rewari. The individual in this role will handle day-to-day accounting activities, including posting journal entries, maintaining ledgers, reconciling bank and vendor accounts, and managing accounts payable and receivable. Responsibilities include preparing invoices, monitoring payments, assisting with monthly and annual closing, and supporting the preparation of financial statements and management reports. The Accountant will ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal policies, while coordinating with internal departments and external auditors as needed. The role also involves maintaining accurate documentation, supporting budgeting and cost tracking, and contributing to process improvements in the finance function.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of general accounting principles, ledger maintenance, and account reconciliation.
* Ability to manage accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, billing, and cash/bank transactions.
* Experience in preparing financial reports, assisting with month-end/year-end closing, and supporting audits.
* Understanding of taxation, compliance, and statutory reporting relevant to manufacturing or industrial organizations.
* Proficiency with accounting software and MS Excel; familiarity with ERP systems is an advantage.
* Excellent attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and organizational skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (such as CA/CPA or equivalent) are a plus.
* Prior experience in an accounting role within a manufacturing or industrial environment is preferred.
